summary: Static validation of Capacitor 6 Android wrapper at /app/mobile + CI workflow + production URL reachability. All wrapper requirements PASS. Production URL responds 200 with 'Facilita AI' HTML and /api/ returns {status:ok, message:'Facilita AI API'}, so the WebView target is healthy. Production build is however OUTDATED (shows badge '10 de 10 usos de IA hoje' and no welcome-modal / no auth gate on Home) — this is a pending redeploy of the web app, NOT a wrapper defect (per review_request note). No Android SDK/emulator in this container, so APK install was not attempted — user will run the GitHub Actions workflow.

integration_issues.issue: Production at https://smart-tools-49.emergent.host is running an older build: badge shows '10 de 10 usos de IA hoje' instead of 3; welcome-modal ([data-testid=welcome-modal]) is absent on Home; Home is accessible without login (no auth-gate). NOT a wrapper defect — capacitor.config.json points at prod correctly; once user redeploys, WebView will render the latest UX.

action_items: User must redeploy the web app to https://smart-tools-49.emergent.host so the latest UX (limit=3, welcome-modal, auth-gate) reaches the Android WebView. No code change needed in /app/mobile.
User runs GitHub Actions 'Android build (Facilita AI)' to produce APK debug + AAB release artifacts.
critical_code_review_comments: capacitor.config.json: appId='com.facilitaai.app' ✓, appName='Facilita AI' ✓, server.url='https://smart-tools-49.emergent.host' (production, not preview) ✓, androidScheme='https' ✓, cleartext=false ✓, errorPath='offline.html' ✓, SplashScreen.backgroundColor='#FF5722' ✓, android.allowMixedContent=false and webContentsDebuggingEnabled=false (good hardening).
AndroidManifest.xml: only <uses-permission android:name='android.permission.INTERNET' /> — no extra permissions. android:exported='true' set on launcher activity (required Android 12+). Good.

app/build.gradle: applicationId='com.facilitaai.app', versionName='1.0.0', versionCode=1. signingConfigs.release is conditional on keystore.properties existing — allows unsigned local build and CI-signed release cleanly. minifyEnabled=false on release (typical for Capacitor WebView wrapper).
Secrets grep of /app/mobile/android for APP_USR|cdf0aaf|MP_ACCESS_TOKEN|JWT_SECRET|MONGO_URL|MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET → 0 matches. capacitor.config.json also clean.

Icons present in mipmap-hdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi (ic_launcher.png + ic_launcher_round.png + adaptive foreground/background). Splash present in drawable/ + drawable-port-* + drawable-land-* across all densities (hdpi..xxxhdpi, incl. night variants).

.github/workflows/android.yml: ubuntu-latest ✓, setup-java@v4 temurin 21 ✓, setup-node@v4 node 20 with yarn cache ✓, yarn install --frozen-lockfile ✓, npx cap sync android ✓, gradlew assembleDebug ✓, upload-artifact 'facilita-ai-debug-apk' pointing app-debug.apk ✓, gradlew bundleRelease ✓, upload-artifact 'facilita-ai-release-aab' pointing app-release*.aab ✓. Optional keystore decode step reads secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 and writes keystore.properties consumed by app/build.gradle — matches contract.
www/offline.html present, pt-BR ('Sem conexão', 'Verifique sua internet e tente novamente. O Facilita AI precisa estar online para funcionar.', botão 'Tentar novamente' que aponta para produção).
Production HEAD/GET returns 200 with <title>Facilita AI — Sua IA para resolver o dia a dia</title>; /api/ returns 200 {status:ok}. WebView target is healthy.

OBSERVATION (not a wrapper bug): produção precisa de redeploy — badge mostra '10 de 10' e não há welcome-modal; assim que o usuário redeployar, o WebView refletirá automaticamente. Nada a mudar em /app/mobile.
